snippet_primary: > "The standard Mollie fee for online credit card transactions ranges from 1.80% + €0.25 to 2.90% + €0.25 per transaction for European Economic Area consumer credit cards from Mastercard and Visa. Rates vary by payment methods, please check Mollie's pricing page for the latest updates. Note that these fees are collected by Mollie and do not go to Payhip."
subject_exact: Fee estándar de Mollie para tarjetas de crédito online: de 1.80% + €0.25 a 2.90% + €0.25 por transacción para tarjetas de consumidor del EEE de Mastercard y Visa; fees recaudadas por Mollie, no por Payhip
local_qualifiers: Rates vary by payment methods, please check Mollie's pricing page for the latest updates
Note that these fees are collected by Mollie and do not go to Payhip
parser_notes: Fees de terceros (Mollie) relayadas por el help center; capas declaradas (no van a Payhip). Mastercard y Visa nombradas en rol de redes de tarjeta.
